notes.title: A word (or two) from Motoi Sakuraba... 🎼✨
notes.content:
Happy Saturday, backers! I hope you've got cartoons and cereal on your docket this morning as we air our trailer in the Future of Play show, Saturday Morning Cartoon-style. We've also got a new social reward unlocked, and some words from our renowned composer! Let's get started!

Goal update!

Stretch Goals

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/a66dab909551003ab04937ee650493f1ac6fdd5d.png

Current goal: Japanese Voice Acting -  €195k/€205k

We're past half way on our progress to our next stretch goal: Japanese Voice Acting! We hope we can hit this before the end of the weekend so we can reveal our next stretch goal in our final week, let's go!

Social Goals

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/7ad2149f03f87a6ed6fb78aa55eca10071892668.png

Current goal: Printable Box Art -  11/12 Goals

We have unlocked our next social goal reward: a mini digital artbook for all tiers! That means even if you didn't back at an artbook tier, you'll get a mini PDF version, which will still give you a taste of some of the art and concepts from development. Plus, the fanart from our contest will be in the mini one as well!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/f15837d21bb72d5113a5fb9e97a2c2ccb3144fb2.png

A word from Motoi Sakuraba…

[previewyoutube=AfFHI1wdC7M;full][/previewyoutube]

As seen in the Future of Play pre-show, here is a word from our soundtrack composer, Motoi Sakuraba!

We've also been lucky enough to ask him some additional questions, which we will include below in English and in the original Japanese. We're grateful we got the chance to hear a bit about his process and revisit some of his past works.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/b99e2f678eb8ade4e18446ac3a8a164b4149571c.png

Q, 取り組んでいるRPG音楽の中で一番好きなタイプは何ですか? (戦闘音楽、キャラクターテーマ、街の音楽など)

Ans, 戦闘曲とダンジョン曲、フィールド曲を作るのが好きです。

Q: What is your favourite type of RPG music to compose? (Battle music, character themes, town music, etc.)

A: I enjoy composing battle music, dungeon music, and field music.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/b99e2f678eb8ade4e18446ac3a8a164b4149571c.png

Q, 静かな雨の午後を過ごし、ゲームのサウンドトラックを聴きながらリラックスできるとしたら、どれを選びますか? 別の質問: 静かな雨の午後、いつもどんな音楽を聴きますか?

Ans, テイルズ　オブ　アライズのサウンドトラックです。山の中に住んでいるので、静かな雨の午後は音楽ではなく、自然の音に耳を傾けています。木に風が当たって聴こえる葉音、鳥の鳴き声等が良く聴こえます。

Q: If you could spend a quiet rainy afternoon relaxing while listening to a game soundtrack, which one would you choose? Another question: What music do you usually listen to on a quiet rainy afternoon?

A: The soundtrack of Tales of Arise. Since I live in the mountains, on a quiet rainy afternoon, I listen to the sounds of nature rather than music. I can clearly hear the sounds of the wind blowing through the trees, the rustling of the leaves, and the chirping of birds.

[previewyoutube=T2zKpeJXh6U;full][/previewyoutube]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/b99e2f678eb8ade4e18446ac3a8a164b4149571c.png

Q, 新しい RPG プロジェクトで音楽を開始するプロセスは何ですか?

Ans, シナリオを読んだり、グラフィックデータ等を参考に世界観を把握します。あとは曲仕様に従って必要な資料を集めたりしてデモ曲を作ります。

Q: What is your process for starting music on a new RPG project?

A: I start by reading the scenario and referring to graphic data to understand the world view. Then, according to the music specifications, I gather the necessary materials and create demo tracks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/b99e2f678eb8ade4e18446ac3a8a164b4149571c.png

Q, ALZARA Radiant Echoesの音楽はどのようなインスピレーションから得ましたか?

Ans, 主人公たちの信念、地中海という場所やそこで使用されている楽器の音色などからインスピレーションを得ました。

Q: What inspired the music for ALZARA Radiant Echoes?

A: I was inspired by the beliefs of the protagonists, the Mediterranean location, and the sounds of the instruments used there.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/b99e2f678eb8ade4e18446ac3a8a164b4149571c.png

Q, 誰かがあなたの作品のミックステープまたはプレイリストを作成するとしたら、どの曲があなたの一連の作品を最もよく表すと思いますか?

Ans,ゲーム音楽に関しては作品の数が多いので、どの曲という風に限定は出来ませんが、「ヴァルキリープロファイル」「バテンカイトス」の通常戦闘曲でしょうか。ゲーム以外だと「戯曲音創」「Forest of glass」の全曲です。これらのアルバムは1曲だけでは成り立っておらず、全曲を聴いて初めて成り立つように作っています。

Q: If someone were to create a mixtape or playlist of your work, which tracks do you think best represent your body of work?

A: Since I have many game music works, it's difficult to specify a single track, but perhaps the regular battle music from "Valkyrie Profile" and "Baten Kaitos." Outside of games, I would say the entire albums of "Gikyokuonsou" and "Forest of Glass." These albums are designed to be understood as a whole, not just by listening to a single track.

[previewyoutube=nLAGa_kDPRo;full][/previewyoutube]

[previewyoutube=fNkRq1Bv6K4;full][/previewyoutube]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/b99e2f678eb8ade4e18446ac3a8a164b4149571c.png

Q,特に扱うのが好きな楽器はありますか?また、それらの楽器はどのようにあなたの音楽に取り入れられていますか?

Ans,ピアノとハモンドオルガンです。ピアノは曲を作り始める時には最初に使う楽器です。オーケストラ編成の曲であっても曲の基本になる部分はピアノで作って、弦や金管楽器の部分を作った後に必要が無ければピアノパートだけ抜いてしまう事もあります。ハモンドオルガンはロック系の激しい曲に音を歪ませて入れる事が多いです。

Q: Are there any instruments you particularly enjoy using? How are they incorporated into your music?

A: Piano and Hammond organ. I use the piano as the first instrument when starting to compose a piece. Even in orchestral arrangements, I create the fundamental parts with the piano and sometimes remove the piano part if it's not needed after adding strings and brass. I use the Hammond organ with a distorted sound in intense rock pieces.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/b99e2f678eb8ade4e18446ac3a8a164b4149571c.png

Q,まだ取り組んだことのない音楽ジャンルでインスピレーションを受けているものはありますか?

Ans,長年作曲をしているので、おそらく殆どの音楽ジャンルは取り組んできていると思います。

Q: Is there a genre of music you haven't tackled yet but are inspired by?

A: I have been composing for many years, so I think I have tackled almost all music genres.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/b99e2f678eb8ade4e18446ac3a8a164b4149571c.png

Q,現代音楽から何かインスピレーションを得ていますか？最近のお気に入りはありますか？

Ans,最近の新しい音楽はあまり聴いていないかもしれません。どうしても昔聴いていた音楽に戻ってしまいます。ただ映画はよく観るので、そのサウンドトラックからはサウンドデザインのインスピレーションを得ていると思います。

Q: Do you get any inspiration from contemporary music? Any recent favourites?

A: I might not listen to much new music lately. I often go back to the music I used to listen to. However, I do watch a lot of movies and draw sound design inspiration from their soundtracks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/b99e2f678eb8ade4e18446ac3a8a164b4149571c.png

Q,仕事中に一緒にいてくれるペットを飼っていますか?

Ans,仕事部屋にはいませんが、ウサギとモルモットを飼っています。

Q: Do you have any pets that keep you company while you work?

A: I don't have any in my workroom, but I do have a rabbit and a guinea pig.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/f15837d21bb72d5113a5fb9e97a2c2ccb3144fb2.png

A Community Playlist

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/b6f228b30971ffa05d06b670f4524edfb15a99e6.png

We are opening up our next JRPG Playlist to our community to celebrate Sakuraba-san's contributions! Our fifth playlist will be made from your suggestions, which you can add to our Discord server in the #jrpg-music channel. The theme for this playlist is “Leitmotifs,” which can mean boss themes, character themes, or any quintessential music that genuinely represents the themes of the game it is in.

A new social goal has also been opened, and once 30 people share their favourite tracks, it will be unlocked! So come help us make a mixtape for the ages!

JRPG Treasures: Vol. 1 / Vol. 2 / Vol. 3 / Vol. 4

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/f15837d21bb72d5113a5fb9e97a2c2ccb3144fb2.png

If you came to us from Future of Play, hello! If you’ve been here the whole time, how did you get in my house…

Thanks again to all our backers; we hope you have a great weekend! It is our FINAL week, so if you’re still looking to back the campaign, you should go do that now! I’ll wait here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/a51aed03591cd22139a93104c55bc79dc67584d6.gif

Until next time!
💛 Colin & the team at Studio Camelia

notes.title: An Interview with Mosqi, an FAQ update, and two new goal unlocks!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we are back this week with a big brand new update for you folks! 

In today's update, we get some answers to questions and unlock a couple of new rewards we earned over the weekend! Let's dive in.

Goal update!

We've unlocked our next stretch goal and social goal reward, which means we'll also examine what's next...

Stretch Goals

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/60a8e9424213a223fc1c4739ac39f1054d26d5a4.jpg

Current goal: Skill Tree Improvements €182.5k/185k

We are glad to include even more character designs from our talented collaborator Yoshiro Ambe! Ambe-san will now help us design four major NPCs, which will bring these characters to life in the same way our heroes have! 

Next, we have a stretch goal to improve and expand on our heroes' skill trees! These improvements will give players ways to specialize and customize the heroes' roles. This feature is still in development, so more detail on hero progression will be available in a later update.

Social Goals

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/35bcf62516a557ed496b888d7cd946a349b8f97c.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/1ca167aaea8d8052433f10324789db57d732045e.png

Current goal: Mini Digtial Artbook - 10/11 Goals

Our next social goal reward is unlocked, and we hit our next tier of Instagram backers! That means our community Discord now has TEN new wonderful emojis to express a wide range of emotions. Up next: a mini digital artbook for all backer tiers that'll be a mini preview of our printed artbook!

Follow us below to help reach it:
Facebook | Instagram | X | TikTok | Discord

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/f15837d21bb72d5113a5fb9e97a2c2ccb3144fb2.png

An Interview with Mosqi

One of our wonderful collaborators on the project is Marcel Mosqi, an incredible artist from our home of Montpellier, France! Mosqi has helped us create the map for our world, a beautiful rendition of a place that once only lived in our imaginations.

We got a chance to ask Mosqi some questions, which we are sharing with you!

Do you have a favourite party member from the Alzara crew?

I love Nakheel's design a lot, but my favourite is Kayla. I love her hair and the colour of her clothes. It's a very original design, with a lot of fine details and very nice "flowing" elements in her outfit, which I like a lot. 

I'm looking forward to discovering more about their stories, personalities, and dilemmas.

What are some of your favourite RPGs?

I started playing JRPGs with Final Fantasy 7, and it remains one of my favourites, although from the same period: Breath of Fire 3 for the sprite design and awesome music, Suikoden 1 & 2, and Grandia for that epic adventure vibe… they are also great inspirations and memories. There are so many, but I also loved Lost Odyssey on Xbox 360, Xenoblade Chronicles, and more recently, I was amazed by Chained Echoes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/a64574d7af2328a105167cbcab333c7ea7597d24.jpg
Chained Echoes (2022), Steam Card Artwork - Marcel Mosqi

If you had control over an element like our heroes do, which would you pick?

I think I'd choose lightning. It's fast and powerful, and it seems that in every mythology, there is a cool-looking god of thunder.

Do you stockpile items in RPGs or use them as needed?

Using consumables is very hard for me, I even try to just forget they exist so I don't get bothered by the dilemma of using them or saving them. But I'm working on it, now I try to use them, and just keep a little aside for boss encounters or hard dungeons. I just really don't like having to farm for potions and such.

Do you have any pets that keep you company while you work?

I don't have pets. I like chocobos though.

If you could live in any RPG settlement, which would you choose?

Probably Costa del Sol in Final Fantasy 7, looks quite peaceful, I love the music, and there is the beach and a cool apartment.

What drew you to work on Alzara in the first place, and what got your attention?

When I was contacted by Emma, who lives in the same city as me, about a RPG she was creating, with a lot of the same references and inspiration I have, in a setting I love using in my illustrations, obviously I immediately wanted to work on the project. And I'm glad it's happening!

How do you define your style, and what inspired it?

I'm really bad at defining my style, and I never really had great control over it, it's just the sum of my inspirations and obsessions. There are obviously Japanese games, manga and anime influences, but I don't know where the rest comes from exactly. I like this idea of influences being processed subconsciously, and active conscious work and study being mixed together. As for my major influences, they come from artists like Tatsuya Yoshikawa, Yuzo Takada, Akihiko Yoshida, Mateusz Urbanowicz, Hidari and many more, including hundreds of incredible amateur and professional artists sharing their work on social media.

When it came to Alzara’s map, what did you look to for reference?

The major reference for Alzara's map was Chrono Cross's world map, but I also gathered a lot of trees and mountains or just grasslands. My main concern was the level of detail and balance between "unique" environments and reused assets. Drawing every tree and shadow differently would have taken way too much time, and would have looked like an illustration more than a RPG world map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/dc7de0e745150341c7b0140c7828dd804adc457c.png
World Map Preview / ALZARA Radiant Echoes - Marcel Mosqi

Your work on your personal project, MaQna, is incredible; what inspired that project?

The main inspiration for MaQna is Saga Frontier 2, which is a beautiful watercolor painted RPG from 1999, I was really impressed by its backgrounds when I played it as a teenager. I decided I would make a few mockups of my "ideal" game project, without realistic constraints. The goal was to try and see if I could make watercolored backgrounds for an RPG. Even if it takes quite some time, I think it is possible with the right scope and a very solid planning and organization.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/abffabff7d00fed343313fa0bf9e849fcbfeeffe.jpg
MaQna Concept Art - Marcel Mosqi

Your designs often balance realism with colour and many fantasy elements; how do you balance these, and how do you make a world feel grounded and fantastical?

Realism is always something I'm worried about, as I love characters to have a few unrealistic or unusable elemens like huge swords or weird armor pieces. Usually I just prioritize a cool design over a realistic one, and try to add small details to make it more believable. I think someone more meticulous would study more thoroughly mechanisms, knots, real armor pieces and such to add to fantasy designs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/f15837d21bb72d5113a5fb9e97a2c2ccb3144fb2.png

FAQ Update

We ran an AmA on Reddit last week (where you can still ask questions!), but we wanted to highlight some of the questions we got and the answers we gave, especially as we’ll be adding these to our Discord FAQ!

When creating the world's different peoples, did you take inspiration from real-world peoples and cultures, and if so, what were some of the inspirations?

We took inspiration from all the countries surrounding the Mediterranean Sea: their people, history, habits, myths, and outfits.

Since our game is about sharing and that the archipelago of Taqsim is a fantasy world, we wanted to create a whole new world based on those inspirations. In that sense, you may recognize that Kayla's skirt pattern is inspired by Minoan elements, Adil's shirt has a Moroccan cut, and Nakheel's tattoos are made with henna... I'm only talking about the heroes here, but we've done the same for all elements of our world! We deeply respect all these cultures and are working hard to blend all of these influences into our fantasy world.

Will there be multiple difficulty settings? How will the game handle difficulty?

Regarding difficulty, when it comes to JRPG, it's more related to strategy, thinking, and how you perceive it. All of this is about balance, and our goal is for the difficulty to be well-adjusted depending on whether you're facing a basic enemy, a boss, or a key boss. Based on these different parameters, the difficulty will vary. That's our goal, but a whole balancing phase will be done during development. For now, we have a single difficulty mode that adapts based on the scenario and combat type. But afterward, we'll have to see depending on the Kickstarter's result. I've seen a few people requesting a difficulty mode, and that's something we could offer via a New Game+ mode, to be determined then.

What kind of sound direction will you have for the soundtrack by Motoi Sakuraba? A higher focus on acoustic and orchestral instrumentation, more progressive rock-style compositions with electric guitars and synthesizers, a la Golden Sun or Star Ocean, or a balanced mix of both?

In terms of music, working with Sakuraba-san has been a delightful experience, and having him involved in the whole soundtrack is such a dream for us as fans of his work! He is always leading the creative process and following his own style, and it's been great so far. When we introduced him to the world of ALZARA, he composed the main theme in a couple of days, immediately getting the Mediterranean vibe. He combines a bunch of instruments that conjure the feeling of the Mediterranean, such as the oud, santur, kaval, castanets, and acoustic guitar, but also keeps room for innovation and inspiration.

What are the Sentinels, and how will backers be able to customize the statues?

The Sentinels are glass statues of Zals and ancient heroes who fell in battle. They play an important role in our world and will be featured in key locations in the game, such as a central plaza in a large city or a key monument in a dungeon.

In terms of design, since we want a certain harmony in these statues, we will propose different models that fit our lore to the backers who selected this tier. The backers will also be able to name the statue. In the game, when you interact with the statue, you will be able to read the name the backer gave it. We are also considering adding text provided by the backer in terms of design.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/f15837d21bb72d5113a5fb9e97a2c2ccb3144fb2.png

That’s it for this Monday update! It’s heavy on questions and answers, but the responses contain some gems, and we think folks will enjoy getting to know Mosqi a bit better. ☺

We’ve got more coming very soon, too, including an interview with Motoi Sakuraba, brand-new art from a couple of talented artists, and a look at the nation of Taqsim, the main setting of our game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/a51aed03591cd22139a93104c55bc79dc67584d6.gif

Until next time!
💛 Colin & the team at Studio Camelia

notes.title: Say hello to Hugust & Nakheel! Plus, a Reddit AMA!
notes.content:
Hey folks!

We’re now into the second week of our Kickstarter campaign, so let’s review our goals and see what comes next…

Stretch Goals

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/f9c11bbeeea804972a124380322ad68081477fbe.png

Next goal & unlock: Full Soundtrack by Motoi Sakuraba - €159k/160k

We're on the cusp of our next stretch goal! (Vinyl backers, don't forget this stretch goal will mean much more Sakuraba for your listening pleasure) Keep an eye out; we will hit it very soon!

Social Goals

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/1c85722aa73e292eb036181c6047f9b60791844e.png

Next goal & unlock: Demo Access - 8/9 Goals

We're also almost at our next social reward, and with a social goal in reach, we're only a handful of new Discord members away from demo access for almost all tiers!

Facebook | Instagram | X | TikTok | Discord

Colin’s Joke Corner

We’ve made some (terrible) puns about our heroes, but what about some of the wildlife in the world of Alzara? (we’re about to take some long walks to some very specific references, but these are my jokes, so buckle up)

Q: Why did the Lusca have to turn in his badge & gun? 
A: He was a loose cannon.

Q: What did the doctor say to the Lusca at their check-up? 
A: “You seem to be missing some tentacles.”

Q: What did the Lusca with imposter syndrome say to their friend? 
A: I’m a fib, Ian!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/f15837d21bb72d5113a5fb9e97a2c2ccb3144fb2.png

Now let's meet our other heroes...

In the next of our deep dives, let's learn more about our other two heroes: Hugust Melissa and Nakheel Kriket. These two have their own reasons for getting involved in the conflict, and their path before the start of our story shaped their destinies…

⛰ Hugust Melissa

Melissa means “The Bee” - Hard-working, dedicated to his cause and his people. A fearsome warrior capable of giving his life. Tends to forget himself, to lose sight of his own importance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/3b8284a9c3a122be9cd95669f5e897d08832f2e6.png

Hugust Melissa is a veteran soldier of the Vedorian army. Nothing can make him falter in battle, though his greatest enemy is his own idea of himself. He believes the journey he is embarking on will give him back the self-confidence he has lost and perhaps allow him to find someone who can see his true worth.

Hugust has spent most of his life working for the Vedorians, as a career soldier. He enlisted at a young age, and he enlisted for the worst reason of all: the prestige of the uniform. At first, he never took his commitment too seriously until he was sent to conflict in the Northlands. After that, the loss of magic eventually transformed the army, which turned to rely on the Dievans, less disciplined mercenaries who were only motivated by money. This conflict and these changes slowly but surely raised questions about his sense of duty and purpose. Hugust lost track of his life and his self-confidence with it. He asked to be sent with the force heading to Taqsim, hoping to find something to hold on to.

Hugust is in his forties, having long served in the army, and his body wears the marks of his training and service. He also has a bit of a belly that won't disappear, but that mostly betrays his affection for confections. He ties his short hair back, hair that seems to be more grey every day. He often looks far away at the horizon, trying to see past his own myopic view of his future. He still wears his Vedorian armour, not only for protection but to hide some parts of his body that he is ashamed of. However, he does not wear the Vedorian helmet and uses a large shield as his weapon of choice.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/e450ff93a1ae3b801d442710b640e254b646ab8e.png

Hugust truly feels he does not have any purpose anymore, though that feeling also comes from Hugust’s lack of luck in love despite many tries. Hugust feels alone because he has been unable to tell anyone about his sorrow. He always tries to look happy to not burden the people around him.

Ultimately, Hugust is resilient. With wounds, bad news, or terrible events, Hugust won't show any sign of weakness except when the pressure cooker explodes, which can be fatal to him. He tries to be stoic but is, in reality, very sensitive. Hugust deals with a lot, but when it comes to sharing that burden, he always forgets to deal himself in.

🌊 Nakheel Kriket

Kriket, or “The Grillon” - A powerful and wise singer, serene advisor and wanderer. Charismatic and reassuring. Not always able to link with reality and other points of view than their own, considered a fool by others.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/12dcf3534d18850771754af904fe827d9f028c72.png

Nakheel Kriket is a venerable sage, despite their young age. The invasion of Taqsim shattered their illusion of peace, bringing conflict to their home. Nakheel tries not to judge and never to hate. Nothing is more important to them than their freedom, and they are willing to fight hard to defend it. Nakheel feels connected to water and is an expert at navigating the seas.

Nakheel is a native of Taqsim and lives in a small fishermen's settlement in East Kalokeri. They originally left their family at an early age as they didn’t agree with their way of living. Since then, they have been drawn to the water’s edge, residing seaside and remaining close to the element that calls to them. This proximity has allowed them to study and learn about the Zals, elemental gods of the world. Mostly, they have lived a solitary life, only seeking out human company when exchanging food for tools and materials to keep their camp in good condition.

Nakheel has an athletic build and stays in shape by swimming and surfing in the sea they live beside. They tend to dress practically, eschewing fashion for clothing and accessories that are comfortable and useful in their everyday life. They don’t care what others think, but only because they don’t often think of themselves from another’s perspective. Their hair is very long, which they keep in a long braid. Their hair certainly has never been cut once in their life. They are calm like water at rest; you can’t imagine them getting nervous or panicking at the first sign of danger. They can also unleash a fury like the seas as well, and in battle they fight with a tall ceremonial axe.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/e450ff93a1ae3b801d442710b640e254b646ab8e.png

Nakheel knows how to take a step back and approach a situation logically and justly. They even take a practical approach when meeting new people and are often quiet so they can learn all about them. Their attention sometimes wanders; they can begin a sentence and never finish it.

Even when they’re able to make anyone speak about themselves, they find it hard to relate to the other person’s motives. At the end of the day, they treasure their liberty and have only one fear: losing it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/f15837d21bb72d5113a5fb9e97a2c2ccb3144fb2.png

✨ We are doing an AmA on the JRPG Subreddit! ‼

Come join Emma (Creative Director) and Colin (Community Developer) on the subreddit this week, Thursday, May 30th, at 10am EDT / 4pm CEST, where we will answer your questions live! We’ll be chatting about the game, and we’d also love to talk about running a Kickstarter campaign, starting a studio, establishing a community, and we’d love to just talk about JRPGs, too!

(You can even ask questions in French, though Colin did not take French past Grade 9, so unless you ask him where the bathroom is, he won’t be able to help you)

notes.title: Let's dive into combat! ⚔
notes.content:
Hello again, friends; we’re back with another update to close out week two of our campaign! Let’s check in on some of our goals…

Stretch Goals

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/4f03a15ddf6246e09df4f7cbae255bfa91f57de1.png

Next goal & unlock: English Voice Acting - €148.5k/150k

We are only €1.5k from our next stretch goal! We are so close, and with your help, we can give voice to the incredible characters our team has been working on. 

Social Goals

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/d66fdf0209efe4f40b7bcb663ae000515ff29be5.png

Next goal & unlock: Animated Discord Stickers - 6/7 Goals

We're also so close to our next social goal! With only a handful of followers on some platforms and a few messages on our Discord goals to go, we are also close to our next reward: demo access for almost all backer tiers (minus the "Keep Me Posted" tier). 

We'll also be starting our TikTok content very soon, and I'll be doing some fun and silly stuff, so come join me there!

Facebook | Instagram | X | TikTok | Discord

Colin’s Joke Corner 

I almost left out my jokes last update, so let’s dive right in! (That was an unintended water pun, but I’ll take it!)

Q: Where does Nakheel like to stay on vacation? 
A: Moat-els!

Q: What does Nakheel say to try and stop a fight? 
A: “Hey, everyone needs to swimmer down!”

Q: As a boat owner, what vegetable does Nakheel avoid the most? 
A: Leeks!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/f15837d21bb72d5113a5fb9e97a2c2ccb3144fb2.png

Combat Deep Dive

Earlier this week, we took a closer look at Kayla & Adil, two of our main heroes and party companions. Today, we’re going to look at what these heroes do when they get into trouble. Let’s talk about combat! (Also, if you’re looking for some music to listen to while you read along…)

Combat in JRPGs is one of the main foundational ways players interact with the world and the story. We have remixed some familiar elements from past titles that inspired us with a new approach that will reward player ingenuity while also allowing those less experienced with the genre to find their footing in combat.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/a74673a39da847d503649ee0700d4ae343d2edad.jpg
Combat UI Breakdown

After entering a random battle, you’ll see the enemies on one side and our heroes on the other! So far, pretty familiar, right? You’ve played JRPGs, and the layout above won’t be too out of left field. What we do with these elements, though (pun intended), is how we make our approach to combat unique!

Elements

Our four core characters each wield a unique element! Kayla has fire 🔥, Adil wields air 🍃, Hugust commands earth ⛰, and Nakheel can control water 🌊. Every enemy also has one or more elements associated with them, which allows the players to use elements to their advantage for damage bonuses.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/157f6f612719753b4efa6cd872f461521bf548cc.png

However, thanks to our swap system, players can combine their elements and unlock even more options to unleash in combat. By combining fire and air, for example, our heroes can summon the power of thunder! ⚡ These new elements can grant an edge in battle! The plant element 🌱 is made up of earth and water, which, because of their inherent weaknesses in fire and air, means thunder will deal 4x the amount of damage!

By successfully mastering our element system, players will be able to defeat even the strongest foes. (Though watch out when they have type advantage on you!) Players will also discover new spells and other new ways to engage with their opponents by combining elements.

https://cdn.myportfolio.com/ef79e859-91d6-47d0-93e5-53aaa618da1e/504edd86-34be-4f23-b49a-d438c4145a8a.gif?h=bffb20f35822025cbc346f01a9a06879

Swap System

In ALZARA Radiant Echoes, our heroes engage in combat in two rows: a front and a back. While heroes are in the front row, they focus on offence, take most of the hits enemies deal out, and do not regenerate their EP (Echo Points).

While in the back row, heroes will focus on support (like healing or buffs), will avoid most direct damage, and will regenerate their EP over time, which will allow them to continue to cast spells. Players must use the swap system in battle to protect their vulnerable members while empowering them to unleash their combined elemental powers against foes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/74579c01b9bba404edf2551ec1ee684567f8cbe9.png
Early concept for the swap system

While in the back row, heroes can also use powerful spells known as Offerings. Each element has a specific offering associated with it, and they can only be cast once by a hero until they swap to the front and return to the back again. These spells will cause the hero to take a temporary (until the offering is used) stat penalty, but this sacrifice allows for Summons: powerful elemental beings who can turn the tide of battle. You’ll need to make an offering to summon, but each offering (up to four!) will further empower the summon’s strength.

Our goal with the swap system is to help make combat feel more dynamic and allow for every party member to shine! ✨

Turn Order

To help players plan their moves and see what comes next, we have our combat turn order at the top of every battle! The heroes’ and enemies’ speed stat will determine their initial placement, but players will be able to manipulate the order during combat to get that last-minute heal spell on an injured companion.

https://cdn.myportfolio.com/ef79e859-91d6-47d0-93e5-53aaa618da1e/2de6d2ee-b747-4472-9b06-534927a41720.gif?h=60c618831d66602d8a9c4b8099605f75

Watch out, though, as some enemies might have a trick or two up their sleeve to move around turn order as well…

Hero Progression

In combat, players will have numerous tactical choices at their disposal! Offensive spells, items found along the way, buffs to help your party, summons that turn the tide of battle, and even hitting an enemy with your good ole’ weapon are all great options for the player.

https://cdn.myportfolio.com/ef79e859-91d6-47d0-93e5-53aaa618da1e/726e87fc-3f2a-42d7-aad2-fa85913e846c.gif?h=b860e63038c6a7c59ab1334a964d1b97

To help empower these options, heroes will level up and advance through a skill tree that will unlock new active abilities and passive bonuses. We’ll go into more detail about our progression systems at a later date as we’re still developing them now!

Random Encounters & Difficulty

While we’re still early in our development, we wanted to touch on a very important topic for JRPGs: random battles and game difficulty. We want to allow players to be able to customize their experience at any time during their playthrough, but we’ll have more details on this soon in another campaign update!

https://cdn.myportfolio.com/ef79e859-91d6-47d0-93e5-53aaa618da1e/3682dbd6-5a98-4207-a038-a414992bc4f0.gif?h=f5e60f6174ae3edb01c2fc8498de9487

We’ll share more combat and our other game mechanics later as we progress in development, but if you have any questions for the team, be sure to join our Discord!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/f15837d21bb72d5113a5fb9e97a2c2ccb3144fb2.png

Food Devils

Have you ever wanted to run a restaurant in a post-apocalyptic world where you power up devils with your food to then conquer your enemies? Well, that is a very specific request, but luckily, there is a perfect game for that!

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2861730/extras/Food_Devils_Cover_Art.gif

The folks over at Studio Daimon are running a Kickstarter campaign right now to find support for their upcoming roguelike/strategy RPG/restaurant sim, Food Devils! With flexible difficulty, multiple devils to meet (and maybe kiss???), and a ton of player choice, this is one to keep an eye on! We’re happy to lend them our support, and we hope folks take a look.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/f15837d21bb72d5113a5fb9e97a2c2ccb3144fb2.png

That’s it for us this week, but we’ll be back next week with a closer look at our other two heroes: Nakheel & Hugust. We’ll also share more lore and have a surprise or two for our community as well! Let’s keep up our momentum as we head into week three!

Until next time!

💛 Colin & the team at Studio Camelia

notes.title: Get to know Kayla & Adil!
notes.content:
Hello, ALZARA backers and community members!

We’re now into the second week of our Kickstarter campaign, so let’s review our goals and see what comes next…

Stretch Goals

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/4f03a15ddf6246e09df4f7cbae255bfa91f57de1.png

Next goal & unlock: English Voice Acting - €150k

We're still working our way to our first major stretch goal! We're almost there with only €4k-ish remaining! After that, our next major stretch goal will be having esteemed composer Motoi Sakuraba on the entire soundtrack!

Social Goals

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/d66fdf0209efe4f40b7bcb663ae000515ff29be5.png

Next goal & unlock: Animated Discord Stickers - 7 Goals

We've unlocked our next major social goal: avatars and banners! This pack of avatars and banners will be available for use on profiles and social accounts on any platform. It's a bit of a throwback to forum signatures (if you are also old enough to remember those!). They will be included in a future Kickstarter update.

Next up for rewards, we have: a pack of animated Discord stickers, expanded demo access to almost all backer tiers (minus the "Keep Me Posted" tier), and a mini digital artbook! 

Edit: I almost forgot my jokes!

Q: What does Hugust like to call himself? (and his shield?)
A: The Rock (and the Hard Place)

Q: What does Hugust call all the rocks he keeps in his pocket?
A: Rockets

Q: What saying does Hugust have hanging above his mantle?
A: "Don't take life for granite."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/f15837d21bb72d5113a5fb9e97a2c2ccb3144fb2.png

Let's get to know our heroes...

In the first of our deep dives, let's examine two of our leads: Kayla Skoros and Adil Pygolampida. These two have grown up together and have been friends for years, but the fragile peace they know is about to be shattered…

🔥 Kayla Skoros

Skoros means "The Phalene" - Attracted to the light, but must learn to turn away from it. Keeper of the vision when night comes. Majestic bearing, inner fragility.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/25d9a6deef78208d150c84a6ce4ed5974ab02994.png

Kayla Skoros is an instructor in Shanidat, the capital of the Taqsim archipelago. She is also heir to the role of leader of the Taqsim. Strong, determined, and radiant, she will realize early on that she will have to take on more responsibility than she ever imagined. She is outspoken and sometimes out of step, but she has a good heart, and nothing matters more to her than her friends. She also hates dirt and loves figs.

Kayla is often bold and likes to take risks, though she never broke a bone! She can tow cabbage carts, lift heavy stones, and mow an entire field, and she likes these activities as they clear her mind and let her focus on staying grounded in herself. She has dark, thick, wavy hair that is as much a source of pride as a hindrance in battle. Her eyes are a fair green and sharp. Her skin is golden from the sun. In combat, she uses a Yataghan, a traditional Turkish weapon which is sabre-like.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/75a97c0e21f8e40b32185dbc39d43e9e269d8bc9.png

She’s stubborn and very self-confident. Truth is, though, that she feels the weight of her lineage and the responsibilities she’ll have to take on. She’s always ready to take part in a fight, either to defend her ideas, for honour or just for the fun of it. She always speaks true, whatever the consequences. Kayla has a tendency to play the hero and often rushes in to save others, even if they don’t need the help.

Her dual education sometimes leads her to take the wrong attitude, mix words, and make mistakes, which can make her awkward to some people. She hates being confronted with her mistakes.

🍃 Adil Pygolampida

Pygolampida means “Firefly” - Light-bearing, fearless, courageous and comforting. Yet weak and harmless, not in control of the consequences of its actions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/7feaa272dd4125cbcb81c3f9e861f2a663e58ef2.png

Adil Pygolampida is a Taqsim diplomacy student who resides in Shanidat with Kayla. Intelligent, perceptive and energetic, Adil has no equal when it comes to convincing. Passionate about fashion, he takes great care of his appearance. Adil is fascinated by the politicking of the ruling class; he believes that his role is to reveal to everyone the decisions and stakes of the upper echelons. His naivety can play tricks on him, however. He can be judgmental of those who don’t match his work ethic.

Adil was found as a newborn on the island of Kalokeri. He was adopted by a poor, working family with no hope of social advancement. He meets Kayla by chance, and they become fast friends after some debate and argument. Thanks to her, he starts studying philosophy and rhetoric, which he follows with great interest.

Adil is thin, has sharp eyes, and is energetic. His movement flows easily like air, almost like he is dancing. He takes care of his looks and acts more noble than he actually is. He wears long coats that enhance his figure and wears numerous rings and accessories to compliment his look. He is very tall, with short dark hair and brown eyes. In battles, Adil plays a flute and is able to create powerful waves using air streams.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/4f870709b235663f05c7f2e405811c6b7fe798b9.png

Adil is a very social person who often imitates someone's mannerisms and traits to understand their way of thinking. He’s a master at persuasion and very curious about everything. On the other hand, because Adil can be very naïve, he deeply believes that people are fundamentally good. He loves jewelry, beautiful fabrics, and all that is luxury. Adil can also turn from theatrical to taciturn in a jiffy.

Adil dreams of going far away and having great adventures so he can one day tell his stories to his children, whom he will adopt, as he himself was once.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/f15837d21bb72d5113a5fb9e97a2c2ccb3144fb2.png

An Ode to Newsletters

If you’ve been on the internet lately, you know that algorithms, search engine optimization, and industry consolidation can make it hard to reach you. Yes, you, the person reading this! Many folks are competing for your attention, and breaking through the noise can be hard.

To help solve this problem, we have a newsletter! You might already even be subscribed to it! This is our way of contacting you directly, removing the stuff that gets in the way and personally dropping a little letter right into your inbox. It’s like a pen pal, except you can’t mail us back, but we do save on postage!

Newsletters are a great way to support the games and developers you are excited about and to get an easy-to-parse update on what we’re doing. During the Kickstarter campaign, we send a new email every week with our updates, but once we’re heads down in development land, we’ll only pop in once a month or so at most to let you know how we’re doing.

We aim to treat our newsletter subscribers like the busy friends you always mean to catch up with. We’ll respect your time and will always be excited to share what we’ve been working on.

If this sounds good to you, subscribe here!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/f15837d21bb72d5113a5fb9e97a2c2ccb3144fb2.png

Thanks for reading our latest update! We’ve still got more for you this week to share, and we are still working towards our stretch and social goals! Things always slow down after the initial launch, but with your help, we can keep the momentum and add even more cool things that we’re excited to share with you.

Until next time!

💛 Colin & the team at Studio Camelia

notes.title: An interview with Ambe, and take our element quiz!
notes.content:
Hello again everyone!

We’re back with a new update as we wrap up our first week! Let's check in with our latest updates to our Stretch & Social Goals…

Stretch Goals
Current goal: €150,000 - English Voice Acting

We are now at €116k and we've gotten a little closer to our first stretch goal! We wanted our first two stretch goals to really make a difference, and we're excited for us to reach to them so let's go!

Social Goals
Current reward: Avatars & Banners [4/5 goals]

We hit our first tier of followers on Twitter! That leaves us only one goal away from our next social goal reward.

I hope folks enjoyed the first set of jokes in our last update, because this next set will blow you away. :D 🌬️

Q: What did Adil say after solving a tricky puzzle?
A: "That sure was a breeze."

Q: Why does Adil wield a flute in battle?
A: It's a woodwind!

Adil is always getting invited to parties, you could say he is often a gust of honor!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/f15837d21bb72d5113a5fb9e97a2c2ccb3144fb2.png

Let’s meet the creator behind our heroes…

In the first of our interviews with our project collaborators, we talk to the acclaimed character designer Yoshiro Ambe! Their work makes Kayla, Adil, Hugust, and Nakheel come alive, and we wanted to ask them a bit about their process and how they approach character design.

Do you have a favourite party member from the ALZARA crew?
I like all of them, but if I had to choose, I would say Adil. I look forward to seeing how he plays a part in the story.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/6d26e6c7ad188104a1dca58ad69229ac7649dcf7.jpg

What are some of your favourite RPGs?
I tend to prefer games with story focusing on multiple protagonists such as Final Fantasy VI, Saga Frontier 2 or Chrono Trigger.

If you had control over an element like our heroes do, which would you pick?
It would be Wind. I really enjoy the gentle wind on sunny days.

Do you stockpile items in RPGs or use them as needed?
When I was younger, I was the type to save items until the last minute, but nowadays I consume them as needed.

Do you have any pets that keep you company while you work?
I don’t have any pets.

If you could live in any RPG settlement, which would you choose?
That would be the colorful universe of ‘Seiken Densetsu’ (aka the Secret of Mana series), which features many luxuriant natural environments.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/0cd71901ad0a26b5aeabd2a87a278fc49d73360b.jpg

What drew you to work on Alzara in the first place, and what got your attention?
When I was approached to work on the project, I was attracted by the natural and magical atmosphere of the world settings.

When designing a character, where do you start?
I usually start working from the overall character silhouette.

Characters often only get seen in one outfit; how do you decide what gets included in that outfit?
I try to give each character a color theme of his own.

How do you make a character feel unique from your other designs?
I always try to add a distinctive point to distinguish it from the others, but even so, I often get a feeling of déjà-vu.

What were your inspirations when designing Kayla?
I tried to design her as a warrior that would appeal to all kind of players, whatever their age or gender.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/4f02eff699628272710af3357a1fd673ff8d0452.jpg

Do you prefer to work digitally or with analog methods? What is that process like?
I usually work on digital for all steps, from the rough sketch to the final art design.

Fashion is an important part of a character’s design; what’s your personal fashion like?
Since I spend a lot of time each day working on my art design, comfort is important to me. I like clothes with simple design.

What makes a character design iconic or become timeless?
This is a point I am still researching every day, and I have not yet been able to grasp the answer. The only thing that comes to mind is to be aware of the fads, but not to over-embrace them.

Your history with the RPG genre is extensive, but is there a genre or style you haven’t done and would like to work on?
I am also interested by different genres such as deformed characters with a comical style. 

Any message for the fans?
I hope you will look forward to discovering more about Alzara in the next announcements. I am myself also impatient to see more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/f15837d21bb72d5113a5fb9e97a2c2ccb3144fb2.png

Which element would you wield?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/7ed1956fe06ab650004df717d229e43e65ae741b.jpg

~Katara voice~ Water, Earth, Fire, Air... which element would you master in the world of ALZARA Radiant Echoes? 

We have a handy dandy quiz to determine this exact answer!

Be sure to share your answers on social media or in our Discord! We've also made these result images so you can more easily share what you got as well! (If you don't want to be spoiled on the results don't look at these until after you take the quiz!)

The quiz is also a great way to get to know our characters and their personality a little bit better!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/ab4aa18116678de78595b1dbdefb60a2b9df30ef.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/df8917ac3b0020148dcfbf69159456437b3a1fb0.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/99eacda3afd1ef4836c729151e28e05eee338e67.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/9221ade7a17887219e874d94afe2f09c65164576.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/f15837d21bb72d5113a5fb9e97a2c2ccb3144fb2.png

That’s a wrap for the first week of our campaign! Thank you to everyone for your kind words and support!

Coming next week: a deep dive into two of our heroes, a closer look at our combat, and more!

Until next time!

💛 Colin & the team at Studio Camelia

notes.title: Fully funded! Plus: Game Inspirations, Music, and Social Goals
notes.content:
Hey folks!

We'll start by saying, we are fully funded!!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/19b1c77f37f6893f6049f93dad1ca0e8e3188d8f.png

Thank you to everyone who has supported us so far, we are reading everything and the team has been blown away by the kindness we've been shown.

We’re now on day two of our campaign! Let's check in with our latest updates to our Stretch & Social Goals…

Stretch Goals

Last unlocked: €100,000 - Fully funded!
Current goal: €150,000 - English Voice Acting
Next goal & unlock: ??? - Motoi Sakuraba on the entire soundtrack!

We are now fully funded and working towards our first stretch goal, english voice acting! The voice acting will primarily be found in main cutscenes, and combat. After that, we have a goal to have composer Motoi Sakuraba take on even more of the soundtrack!

Social Goals

Last unlocked: Jokes & puns [3 goals]
Current goal: Avatars & Banners [5 goals]
Next goal & unlock: Discord emojis [7 goals]

We unlocked our first social goal! Which means all of our updates will now have jokes. Well, it will have attempts at jokes. Here's a few for you folks:

Q: Why does Kayla always seem to get into trouble?
A: She likes to get into some heated debates.

Q: Why did Kayla drop out of cooking class?
A: She got out of frying pans, and more into fire.

Q: Why is Kayla always getting wax everywhere?
A: Because she's burning the candle at both ends!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/f15837d21bb72d5113a5fb9e97a2c2ccb3144fb2.png

Celebrating what we grew up with…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/7e9ef78ba675301690fbc623c268fe37e348369e.png

Last week, ahead of our Kickstarter launch, we celebrated some of the inspirations that helped pave the way for ALZARA Radiant Echoes. JRPGs are such an important part of our gaming history, as we have memories of seemingly endless summer vacations, rainy Sunday afternoons, quiet 1am nights, and dark car rides by the light of the streetlamps spent saving the world.

As ALZARA is a throwback to these times, we wanted to create fun assets that celebrate these games. I still remember a time when magazines were one of the key places I learned about games. I would pour over previews or even ads as they were my small window into possible adventures. Sometimes, all I had to go off of was a game's box art at a rental store.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/2b1daeb7182a21143d6408c2a6fb93c105281854.png

We hope these bring back some fond memories and help get you excited about the new memories you’ll make while playing ALZARA!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/50d65b9d8ff42e481ccdcec08b5d6944b6459c1f.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/f15837d21bb72d5113a5fb9e97a2c2ccb3144fb2.png

…and sharing what comes next!

Yesterday, we introduced one of our collaborators, Motoi Sakuraba!

We hope to have our entire score created by him, which is one of our upcoming stretch goals! To help push towards this goal, we wanted to talk about music.

Music is incredibly important to a JRPG! If I even mention something like “The Man with the Machine Gun,” you can hear the opening notes in your head. (If you need to go listen to it, I’ll wait. I’ll be here in your other browser tab.)

In our game, our characters fight against an invasion, hoping to bring peace to their lands. Hope is, therefore, a central element of the game as well.

We also noticed that game music today is often used simply as background music today. For ALZARA, we want music to play a key role in the player’s perceived emotions, and that's why the soundtrack of the game will consist of melodies that players can hum along to.

Our main musical references come from games we grew up with, such as Golden Sun, Baiten Kaitos or Valkyrie Profile. We want to recreate the feelings we got from these games, but with a more up-to-date approach.

This is why we called on Motoi Sakuraba, a renowned composer who worked on the soundtracks of those exact games we mentioned.

With that in mind, let’s listen to the main theme of ALZARA that Sakuraba-san has been working on:

Soundcloud link: https://soundcloud.com/g4f-records/main-theme-alzara-radiant-echoes/s-rDPsKEJdTjO

Main Theme - Motoi Sakuraba

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/f15837d21bb72d5113a5fb9e97a2c2ccb3144fb2.png

Social Goals

So you're asking yourself... what is a social goal??? They are kind of like our stretch goals, but are focused on growing our community while also giving back to it! The goals range from growing our social accounts, to sharing photos in our Discord server.

Most of the social goals are straightforward, but our community goals might need some clarity!

Fan Art - We'd love to see any fan art folks make! You can share it on socials and tag us so we see it, or you can share it in our Discord server!

Closet Cosplay - While cosplay can be a lot of hard work and preperation - we'd love to see our community try and dress like our characters just by using whatever they have laying around! You can tag us in the post on socials, or share your outfit on our Discord.

Favorite JRPG Merch / JRPG Inspired Pets - We have a channel in our Discord (aptly named #jrpg-merch-and-pets) where you can share your favorite merch you own from JRPG games, or share your pets (especially if they are named after something or someone from a JRPG)!

??? - You'll have to wait and see!

Social Goal Rewards

The rewards for completing social goals with range from expanding our Discord server to digital bonuses, to even physical merch upgrades and additional rewards! They are our way of saying thank you to our community, and some rewards will be available to everyone - whether you're a backer or not!

Just in case you need 'em, here's some links to all of our socials!

Twitter
Facebook
Instagram
TikTok
Discord

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/f15837d21bb72d5113a5fb9e97a2c2ccb3144fb2.png

Keep an eye out later in our campaign as we share an interview with Motoi Sakuraba about his work on ALZARA, his favourite music, and some answers to some other fun questions we got to ask him!

That’s it for this update! I’ll be back tomorrow with a check-in on the campaign, a round-up of press coverage, and some answers to some of your questions!

Until next time!

💛 Colin & the team at Studio Camelia

notes.title: Sakuraba & Ambe, Stretch Goals Reveal, and our Discord server!
notes.content:
Hello to our wonderful community!

First of all, thank you & merci for your support of our campaign on Kickstarter to help us make ALZARA Radiant Echoes a reality. We are so excited to be working on a love letter to any of the JRPGs we grew up with, and we are grateful to everyone who joins us on this journey.

In this first update, we are going to introduce two of our exciting collaborators, share our early stretch goals, and share the corner of the internet we’ve carved out to bring our community together: Discord!

Now, here's a bit of an intro for myself: Hello folks, my name is Colin! I am the community developer for Studio Camelia during our crowdfunding campaign. I’m the voice behind our updates and our social media, and I’m the admin of our Discord server! I’m very excited to help this team bring this project to life, and I’ll be here for the whole campaign to support the team and you: our community!

Now, without further ado, let’s introduce some folks you might recognize…

Introducing our composer, Motoi Sakuraba…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/4a7ee17ba89df0a547f17f6f07c000bafe09c106.jpg

We are very excited to work with Sakuraba-san on the ALZARA Radiant Echoes score. We are huge fans of his work, and we believe the game will truly sing with his music backing our most powerful moments. Overcoming a powerful boss, visiting a peaceful seaside town, sacrificing something dear to bring peace… these memorable moments are found in many RPGs, but with the right music behind them, they can become something more.

As our campaign continues, we’ll have more to share from Sakuraba; he is prominently featured in one of our stretch goals!

…and character designer Yoshiro Ambe!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/75e80e62512dbbd9de3d9ea3fc006eab4868284e.jpg

Our party comes to life with the help of acclaimed character designer Yoshiro Ambe! We wanted ALZARA to feel classic and even timeless, a throwback to the JRPGs of our youth. Thanks to Ambe’s work on Kayla, Adil, Hugust, and Nakheel (and others to be revealed), we feel that our core party could easily exist in 2024 or would be just at home in 2004 on a PS2. The party is the heart of our game, and with Ambe’s contributions, we believe our heroes will stand tall in the pantheon of RPG protagonists.

Stretch Goals

We are close to unlocking our stretch goals! With full funding right around the corner, let’s talk about what comes next! For anyone unfamiliar, Stretch Goals are higher tiers of additional funding that upgrade rewards, unlock additional in-game content, and more! (Social Goals are similar but focus more on building on our community and providing smaller upgrades for backers)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/5cfb4cac6f4cf75496a1b0ed3ff64bdcbd2495b2.png

Our very first stretch goal is for English voice acting, specifically for our major cutscenes and for in combat! We’ll update our goals every week day and share progress through our social media, Kickstarter updates, Discord, and our newsletter!

We’re grateful for the support shown so far, and we have some fun goals ahead of us to unlock! We also want to add that console porting is not part of our stretch goals at any point. We plan to release on consoles, though specific consoles will be announced later in development. This gives us the opportunity to start conversations with potential platforms that could help us with additional funding, marketing, or other support for those console ports.

Say hello in our community Discord server!

We have a Discord server! We know what you’re thinking: why should I join this server???

Our server has a few fun benefits: We’ll have contests, giveaways, and Q&As with the team. We also kept it pretty small and straightforward, so you don’t have to navigate a billion channels and can go straight to the good stuff. We also intend it to be a great spot for JRPG fans to chat, with forums set up to discuss the classics or more modern titles.

We know folks’ server lists can get long and a bit unwieldy, so we wanted to ensure we earn a spot on yours by being straightforward and cutting out the cruft. You also won’t get ANY notifications you don’t want, except we probably do one or two “@everyone” for the big announcements. We get excited.

You can join the server here: http://tiny.cc/alzaradiscord

(For backers: Keep an eye out on a separate update very soon on Kickstarter with instructions on how to get your "Backer" titles in the Discord server!)

Don't miss out on Runa!

Runa is an adventure game inspired by modern and classic JRPG, with a turn-based battle system, social links and a story-rich science fantasy world. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/38c0f5926af16fa5c5571834d862b051a6f8467f.png

Promising to keep intact what makes classic JRPG games fun, Runa also features elemental puzzles and base building, as well as minigames like farming, fishing, and cooking.

The campaign is ending soon, so don't miss the chance to support Runa! (Late pledges will also be after the campaign ends!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45020264/f15837d21bb72d5113a5fb9e97a2c2ccb3144fb2.png

Thanks to everyone for your support. This is just the first of many updates planned! We have interviews with our collaborators, deep dives into our world and gameplay, and some fun additional content that celebrates the culture and community around JRPGs.

Until next time,

💛 Colin & the team at Studio Camelia
